Vulcans celebrated the vast differences across the universe and honored the ways people developed. This outlook underpins their wider cultural interest in learning, personal growth, and exploration. What began as a bit of narrative to describe another species' outlook soon evolved into the driving philosophy of Star Trek itself: diversity is strength and diversity is beautiful! Conveniently (and probably because we're also a bunch of Star Trek fans), we think diversity is a strength here in Studio X as well! Magic: The Gathering has thrived by trying new things, embracing new genres, and inviting new perspectives. Arguably, the most mechanically relevant application of diversity in Magic is its creature types.
